sections.title: What are Participles?
points: Participles are verb forms that function as adjectives
Two types: Present Participles (-ING) and Past Participles (-ED/-EN)
Present Participle: Shows ongoing or continuous action
Past Participle: Shows completed action or state

sections.title: Present Participles (-ING)
points: Example: The running dog is fast
Example: We saw a flying bird
Example: The sleeping baby woke up
Describes an action that is happening NOW

sections.title: Past Participles (-ED/-EN)
points: Example: The broken window needs repair
Example: The painted house looks beautiful
Describes something that was done or completed

sections.text: Tip: Present Participles (-ING) = active action | Past Participles (-ED) = completed/passive action
